hosts.name: Andrew Lathers
hosts.bio: Bourbon enthusiast and podcast host with over a decade of experience exploring American whiskey. Andrew's journey began in Kentucky, where he developed a deep appreciation for the craft and tradition behind every bottle. When not tasting, he's exploring distilleries and sharing stories of bourbon's rich heritage.

hosts.name: Sarah Mitchell
hosts.bio: Certified bourbon steward and co-host bringing a scientific perspective to whiskey appreciation. Sarah's background in chemistry gives her unique insights into the art and science of distillation. She believes great bourbon tells a story that begins in the grain fields and ends in your glass.

guests.name: Master Distiller James
guests.bio: Award-winning master distiller with 30 years of experience crafting bourbon at some of Kentucky's most prestigious distilleries.

guests.name: Whiskey Historian Dr. Chen
guests.bio: Academic expert on American whiskey history, author of 'The Bourbon Trail: A Journey Through Time'.

guests.name: Sommelier Kate Williams
guests.bio: Certified sommelier who bridges the gap between wine and whiskey appreciation, bringing fresh perspectives to tasting.
